entities.name: the 汴河, west reach (u 15500-18300)
entities.what: The river as a broad diagonal band of plain silk with ink ripple motifs, running along the top of the silk: open water from the silk's top edge (west of u ~16150 the far bank is beyond the edge) down to the south bank at v ~900-1060, between the far-bank strip of shops and moored boats and the riverside hall, the tavern's trees, the shed and the bridge's south-west foot.
entities.vis: part: the south shore is hidden behind reeds, roofs, the shed and the unloading boat; the north shore behind the moored boats
entities.note: No shoreline is inked in this reach; both lines are estimates. shore_n: west of u ~16150 the water runs to the silk's top edge (no far bank painted; a willow crown hangs from beyond the edge at 15200-15570, v 15-70); at 16150-16390 it is the lower edge of the wash-drawn bank slope below the trackers' path; at 16390-18300 it runs hidden behind the moored boats B3-B6 (their far gunwales at v ~230-300), about 10-30 px below the far bank's ground edge (bank_top of S3.grd.bank_n_16150). shore_s: hidden. 15500-15900: behind S4b's willow crown and the reeds south of S4b's big rafted boat (its hull bottom at v ~820-850, its sweep blade reaching (15856, 893)); 15900-16420: just above the riverside hall's north roof edge (v ~950), where the reeds (v 850-950) grow; 16420-17480: no ink between the lowest ripples (v ~650 at 16500-16900; v 980-1020 behind the 新酒 banner at 17280-17400) and the tree bases and roofs (v ~1100+), so interpolated; 17560-17950: behind the mat-roofed shed's north eave (v ~935) and the unloading boat's hull (v 870-925); 18080-18300: round the north-west edge of the land at the bridge's south foot, where t5's crowd stands (figures at 18210-18300, v 640-800). Reading error about +-30 px everywhere (+-60 px at 16420-17480). Ripple motifs are drawn all over the open water (e.g. 15550-16000 v 520-600, 16450-16900 v 550-650, 17250-17400 v 700-1020). FRAME: shore_s point 0 is S4b.water.bian_river's shore_s at u 15500 (read from map/strokes/S4b.json each run; was this agent's (15500, 915, est), 19 px south). The north shore at the seam: S4b's far bank (S4b.grd.far_bank_15330: bank_top (15500, 75), shore (15500, 112), est) meets S3.grd.far_bank_seam_15500, which turns it off the silk's top edge by u ~15650; between there and u 16150 the water runs to the silk's top edge as this note says.

entities.name: far (north) bank of the river, u 16150-18300
entities.what: The far bank: at 16150-16450 a wash-drawn earth slope rising north-east from the water to the path the five trackers climb; east of it a narrow strip of ground with bare trees and a willow, then shops with tables and stilted platforms along the top of the silk, the moored boats lying along its edge.
entities.vis: part: hidden behind the moored boats east of 16390
entities.note: bank_top = the ground's edge nearest the water. 16150-16450: the top of the wash band (bank slope 16150-16450, v 120-290; ink-wash patches only, no inked edge); the trackers' path climbs above it from (16330, 128) to (16430, 78) and off the top edge. 16450-17000: behind B3's cabin roof, est from the ground behind it (tree feet at v ~200-245, a row of rough strokes at 16600-16850 v 205-245 that may be stones or a low revetment). 17250-17650: the wash-drawn ground in front of the shops' tables (table legs at v 150-170) ends at v ~195-210. 18200-18330: the ground with a table and seated man (18270, 130) ends at the festooned line at v ~235-245. The far-bank hall on posts at 18330-18600 (structures_e) has its posts' feet at v ~245-265, at or in the water's edge. Never a vertical face: no stair or quay is drawn on this bank in u 15500-18300.

entities.name: near (south) bank of the river, u 15500-18300
entities.what: The south bank, never drawn as an edge: the riverside hall stands with its north eave at the water, reeds and bushes grow in front of it, then the tavern's bare trees, the 新酒 banner, the mat-roofed shed with the unloading boat moored along it, and the land at the bridge's south-west foot where the crowd stands at the water.
entities.vis: part: the bank faces away from the viewer and is hidden everywhere
entities.note: Read as the line where land things begin (the hall's north roof edge, the tree feet, the banner's ground, the shed's north eave, the crowd's north-west edge at the bridge foot); within the reading error (+-30 px, +-60 px at 16420-17480) it coincides with shore_s of S3.water.bian_west_15500. No landing stair, jetty or quay is painted on this bank in u 15500-18300. FRAME: point 0 is S4b.grd.near_bank_14850's bank_top at u 15500 (read from map/strokes/S4b.json each run; was (15500, 930, est), 15 px south).

entities.name: boat under way, sculled with a stern sweep (摇橹向前?)
entities.what: A mid-sized river boat with a big arched mat roof over most of its length (15610-15900, v 300-470; the restyle tiles it), a high rounded bow at the west end with a curved beam projecting west (15555-15600, v 275-290) and an A-frame of two poles at the bow; three men stand at the bow (on the raised foredeck) and five work a long sweep (橹) over the low stern at the east end: its loom runs from the crew past a pivot at (15965, 503) to a blade lying in the water at 16070-16135, v 555-570. Cargo under the roof (no figures painted inside). No mast up.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: 名画记: 河边泊船 (纤夫) (pin 25 at 15690); 余辉: 摇橹向前
entities.note: WHICH END IS THE BOW: read as bow west (facing ~162, moving west): the 橹 is a stern oar worked over the stern, and the west end carries the high rounded stem and the projecting beam that the towed boat B2 carries at its bow. Other reading: bow east with a bow sweep (Song river boats also steer with a bow sweep; S4b's big rafted boat has a sweep at its east end, which S4b reads as its bow): then front/rear swap and facing ~342. SCALE CUE: waterline length ~370 px along the hull (15595-15955), painted height bow top to waterline ~140 px; crew painted 60-90 px tall (bow men ~62 px, stern men ~80 px). WATERLINE: beam_s = the hull's lowest near-side outline (v 515-528 at 15700-15900); the ends est where the outline turns up (west end outline at 15578, v 380-420); beam_n hidden behind the roof (est from the far gunwale at the stern deck and the roof's far edge). Sweep blade 16070-16135 at v 555-570 lies on the water south-east of the stern.

entities.name: boat unloading at the south bank
entities.what: A cargo boat moored along the south bank with its bow west toward the 新酒 pole: a short bow beam with a small hanging box (17650-17700, v 820-850), a multi-pronged grapnel anchor (4-5 hooked prongs) hanging under the bow (17700-17780, v 855-930) and a long pole or sweep running from the bow west-south-west over the water to ~(17480, 885); six men stand and bend on the foredeck (17700-17950, v 800-830) over jars and bundles (a jar at (17728, 770-800)); dark sacks or baskets heaped amidships (17900-17990, v 850-890); the stern half (17950-18250) is covered by an arched mat hood (18095-18200, v 735-800) and flat lattice mat awnings on poles (17960-18330, v 740-880; poles at ~18010 and ~18170).
entities.vis: part: the stern hidden by the mat awnings and t5's parasol (18050-18250, v 870-980)

MATS: read as this boat's stern cover; other readings (the restyle and overview paint stalls): a second, mat-hooded boat moored astern of it (hull hidden), or a mat-awning stall on the bank (then t4's or t5's prop). Its hull ends where t5's parasol stall begins. SCALE CUE: waterline ~415 px; crew 110-135 px tall; bow beam ~45 px. The grapnel: prongs splay from (17740, 855) to tips at (17710, 915), (17730, 925), (17745, 915), (17760, 910), (17775, 895); other reading: a bundle of poles or oars hanging into the water. The long pole from the bow to ~(17480, 885) passes the 新酒 pole's crossed frame (t4's prop at 17605) without touching it. Second pass: the arched stern hood spans u 18095-18200 (its arch from (18093, 760) over (18150, 737) to (18202, 792); scratchpad/S3_second_middle/c_stern2.jpg, c_stern_plain.jpg), so the stern is under its east end: rear moved from (18120, 950, est), which lay under the hood's middle, to (18210, 958, est) on the hull line (17780, 850) -> (18050, 940) carried east under the big parasol. The flat lattice panel reaches (18327, 812-825). East of ~18190 that panel lies over the south ramp's west edge (the deck's far edge is ~720 px west of deck_e: 18190 at v 840), so its east part may be an awning of the stall at the ramp's edge (the tray stall) rather than the boat's; the boat ends at the deck's edge either way. Waterline length now ~505 px.
